titleText: Low-income families to benefit from €4.7m support scheme
mainText: From Times of Malta: Low-income families to benefit from €4.7m support scheme. Familja+ programme expected to benefit 7,000 children, to cover essential household items, mental health, extracurricular activities

titleText: Activists map Senglea seafront restaurants to highlight alleged illegalities
mainText: From Times of Malta: Activists map Senglea seafront restaurants to highlight alleged illegalities. Interactive map compares planning permits with photos of outdoor seating along the promenade

titleText: MHRA warns rising licence fees and eco-contribution risk undermining Malta’s tourism competitiveness
mainText: From The Malta Independent: MHRA warns rising licence fees and eco-contribution risk undermining Malta’s tourism competitiveness. The Malta Hotels and Restaurants Association (MHRA) has called on the government to review rising costs imposed on the tourism industry, warning that higher licence fees, increased eco-contributions and expenses related to employing third-country nationals risk undermining Malta's competitiveness.

titleText: Woman denied bail in connection with €87,000 fraud scheme
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Woman denied bail in connection with €87,000 fraud scheme. A 38-year-old woman was remanded in custody on Thursday after pleading not guilty to a series of charges in connection with an alleged fraudulent scheme involving a car rental business and the renting out of apartments.

titleText: Malta-registered tanker sinks off Ibiza, one crew member dies
mainText: From MaltaToday: Malta-registered tanker sinks off Ibiza, one crew member dies. A Malta-registered tanker sank off the coast of Ibiza, Spain, in the early hours of Thursday 26 November, leaving one crew member dead, Transport Malta has confirmed.
